messages:
alex: Heads-up — our Cloudflare worker sample broke after the exports map tweak; authRetry is undefined in the runtime.

maria: Which sample? Full error?

alex: examples/edge-chatbot, running with wrangler dev.
Error:
```
TypeError: RedwoodSDK.authRetry is not a function
    at handleRequest (/worker/dist/edge/index.mjs:42:15)
```
Node-based local testing (require) works fine.

jun: Likely a package resolution mismatch. The conditional exports we added may be hiding the edge-specific entry so the bundler picks a CJS fallback without authRetry.

sam: Repro:
1) git checkout main
2) yarn
3) cd examples/edge-chatbot
4) wrangler dev
5) GET /
=> crash

dev-bot: CI failure: samples/test-edge job failed on PR #1245 (bundle check)

alex: Observed that some worker bundlers prioritize the "module"/"browser" condition or ignore exports and fall back to main/module. Our authRetry landed only on the ESM build like ./dist/index.mjs so workers that picked ./dist/index.cjs or a subpath didn't get it.

jun: Quick fixes:
- add a dedicated '@redwood/inference/edge' subpath in exports that always points to an edge-ready ESM build + types
- or ensure authRetry is exported from both ESM and CJS top-level bundles

sam: Draft PR WIP: adds "./edge": { "import":"./dist/edge/index.mjs","default":"./dist/edge/index.cjs" } and re-exports in dist bundles. https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1261

maria: Typings also broke for TS consumers on Edge. Need dist/edge/index.d.ts exposed via typesVersions or explicit types mapping.

alex: Short-term customer workaround: import directly from '@redwood/inference/dist/edge/index.mjs' or pin previous SDK. Not ideal.

jun: We should add an esbuild/wrangler resolution test to samples CI to catch this next time.

sam: I'll push PR and add unit/test for typings and edge bundling.

maria: Also add a migration note and docs entry: "Edge runtime: prefer '@redwood/inference/edge' until exports map stabilizes". Who will draft release note?

alex: I'll write the release note and push a canary tag that preserves old exports for a short window.

dev-bot: Tasks assigned: @sam PR, @jun tests, @alex release note. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

sam: :thumbsup

maria: Good catch. Let's be conservative with conditional exports in future releases.
